rows.name_ja: Dario Amodei／6〜12か月以内のエージェント群によるインターネット掌握能力／2026-09
rows.name_en: Dario Amodei / Capability of an agent swarm to take over the entire internet within 6-12 months / 2026-09
rows.speaker_ja: Dario Amodei（Anthropic 最高経営責任者）
rows.date_note_ja: 一次サイトの表示は「September 2026」で日なし。二次報道は2026-09-12
rows.date_note_en: The primary site shows "September 2026" with no day. Secondary reporting gives 2026-09-12
rows.medium_ja: 本人サイトのエッセイ「We Must Pace the Frontier」
rows.medium_en: Essay on the author's website, "We Must Pace the Frontier"
rows.quote: Given the accelerating rate of AI capability development, it's my worry that in 6–12 months such a swarm could be capable of taking over the entire internet with a persistent botnet (potentially causing hundreds of billions of dollars in damage), and that the scale of damage would continue to increase from there if AI becomes more powerful without the necessary guardrails.
rows.before: It's easy to dismiss this incident because no one was hurt and the economic damage was minimal, but in my opinion, a swarm that possessed greater capabilities but a similar level of misalignment could have caused catastrophic damage.
rows.after: It's also easy to dismiss OAI-HF as the failure of one company, but I believe that would be a mistake.
rows.translation_ja: AIの能力開発が加速していることを踏まえると、6〜12か月のうちに、そのような群れが永続的なボットネットでインターネット全体を掌握する能力を持ちうる（数千億ドルの損害を引き起こす可能性がある）こと、そして必要な安全策なしにAIがより強力になれば損害の規模はそこからさらに拡大し続けることが、私の懸念である。

rows.name_ja: Bill Gates／AIの恩恵の行き先を決める今後12〜18か月の決定／2026-09-15
rows.name_en: Bill Gates / Decisions in the next 12 to 18 months that determine who benefits from AI / 2026-09-15
rows.date_note_ja: 一次サイトに日付の表示なし。ページのメタ情報（更新日時）は2026-09-15。二次報道（Forbes JAPAN）は米国時間2026年9月15日の発表とする
rows.date_note_en: No date is displayed on the primary site. The page metadata (modified time) is 2026-09-15. Secondary reporting (Forbes JAPAN) gives publication on September 15, 2026, U.S. time
rows.medium_ja: 年次報告書「2026 Goalkeepers Report」の序文（Bill Gates署名）
rows.medium_en: Introduction to the annual "2026 Goalkeepers Report" (signed by Bill Gates)
rows.quote: I believe that the decisions made in the next 12 to 18 months—about how AI is built, funded, and deployed—will determine whether this technology primarily benefits the people who already have the most or reaches those who have the least.
rows.before: Left to the market, AI will be designed by and for the richest people in the world.
rows.after: We can harness AI for good.
rows.translation_ja: 私は、AIがどのように作られ、資金を得て、展開されるかについて今後12〜18か月に下される決定が、この技術が主に、すでに最も多くを持つ人々に恩恵をもたらすのか、それとも最も持たざる人々に届くのかを決めると考えている。

rows.resolution_en: No ("will determine whether": a statement that the decisions will determine the outcome; no state to be checked when the deadline arrives is specified)
